mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.created_by, u.name AS created_by_name, n.is_pinned, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM notice n LEFT JOIN users u ON n.created_by = u.user_id ORDER BY n.is_pinned DESC, n.created_at DESC

SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.created_by, u.name AS created_by_name, n.is_pinned, n.created_at, n.updated_at FROM notice n LEFT JOIN users u ON n.created_by = u.user_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (title, content, created_by, is_pinned, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{createdBy}, #{isPinned}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title=#{title}, content=#{content}, is_pinned=#{isPinned}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE notice_id=#{noticeId}
